name: present-keys-are-written-as-their-values
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `null`: the option acts only for an absent key, so every held key is written as before (0.5 canonical output, members in field-line order: id, label, q, x, code, s, items). `s` is one member on two lines: decode fills probe.s1 and probe.s2 with "v" (ruling 16 of 0.5); encode writes the earliest held line once. Derived by hand.
